name: Dangerous Love
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.

It's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.

Find one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
narrative.objectives: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: So it is true. This is unbelievable. How could this have happened? Let me think for a moment. There must be a reason behind this.
narrative.requestItemsText: Was I right to worry? Have our idiot guardians been overcome?
